title: Topic Focus Database
descriptions: The Topic-Focus Database gives information about the ways in which languages give formal expression to information-structural categories such as Topic, Focus and Contrast, and their many subtypes. Expression strategies considered include syntactic, morphological and prosodic means of indicating the informational status of a constituent. A further parameter considered concerns the nature of the targeted constituent.
